name: Brace Ring
text: Your first card that gives you Block each turn gives 3 more.

name: Blood Battery
text: The first card that costs you health each turn gives 1 energy. Actual health must be lost.

name: Tripwire
text: After your third manually played Attack each turn, gain 3 Block. Once per turn.

name: Folded Note
text: Your first deliberate discard each turn draws 1 card. End-turn discards do not count.

name: Glass Filter
text: The first time your card applies Poison each turn, gain 3 Block.

name: Recycler
text: The first card you exhaust each turn draws 1 card.

name: Relay Pin
text: The first time your card effectively helps another player each turn, draw 1 card.

name: Capacitor
text: Your first damaging hit from an Attack kept across a turn gains 4 damage. Once per turn.

name: Opening Lens
text: Draw 1 extra card at the start of each encounter.

name: Spare Shell
text: Start each turn with 2 extra Block.

name: Repair Kit
text: After your first victory at a route node, heal 3. Cannot revive you. Retries cannot repeat this reward.

name: Overcharged Coil
text: On the first turn, gain 1 energy but draw 1 fewer opening card.

name: Shield Spool
text: Keep up to 6 Block when your turn starts. Combines with Bastion using the higher limit.

name: Red Thread
text: The first card that spends your health each turn gives 5 Block.

name: Pocket Flint
text: Your first deliberate discard each turn creates 2 free Sparks. Once per turn.

name: Silver Needle
text: Your first zero-cost Attack each turn gives 2 Block.

name: Sealed Vial
text: Your first card applying Poison each turn also applies 2 Poison to every other standing enemy.

name: Scrap Furnace
text: Your first Exhaust each turn gives 1 energy. Once per turn.

name: Tuning Fork
text: The first time a card gives you Charge each turn, gain 4 Block.

name: Long Memory
text: After your first Attack kept across turns, draw 1. Once per turn.

name: Spare Page
text: From turn 2 onward, draw 1 extra card each turn.

name: Empty Flask
text: The first time you spend your last energy each turn, gain 1 energy. Once per turn.

name: Team Ribbon
text: The first card that gives another player Block, health, energy or cards each turn gives you 4 Block.

name: Soft Landing
text: Start each turn at half health or less with 6 extra Block. Does not revive you.
